lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill region; nodes are aligned in roughly vertical columns with consistent inter-nodal spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a visible lattice structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank showing a sharp vertical luminance gradient, characterized by high-intensity highlights on the upper margin and low-intensity shadows below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large V-shaped excision on the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin; cluster of five dark vertical linear markings immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced gradient in spot size and density, transitioning from high-density punctate clusters on the anterior cephalic region to larger, discrete nodes on the posterior flank.
